name: stripe
description: Full programmatic access to every Stripe API endpoint the pinned stripe-node SDK exposes, across many accounts. Multi-account (standalone keys and Connect), binary-enforced safety tier with live-mode arming, bundled Stripe CLI for webhooks. Proactively activates for: (1) any Stripe data lookup or operation, (2) cross-account Stripe reporting, (3) webhooks and CLI tasks.

accounts_file.title: Accounts registry file
accounts_file.description: Path to the JSON accounts registry. If unset, defaults to the plugin data dir.

default_account.title: Default account name
default_account.description: Account name used when no --account is given.

bulk_threshold.title: Bulk scope-review threshold
bulk_threshold.description: A single-account write affecting more than this many items requires bulk scope review.

enable_mcp_shim.title: Enable optional MCP shim
enable_mcp_shim.description: Expose stripe_call and stripe_accounts as MCP tools. Off by default; the primary path is the CLI plus skills.
